description:
Detect attacks on VPN concentrators (Pulse Secure, Fortinet, etc.)

⚠️ NEEDS-REWRITE: Query is generic SQL, needs conversion to Cloud Guard detector condition

dataSourceDetails.query: SELECT "siem_initial_access_initial_access_132", "data__json.message" FROM "oci_monitoring_metricexplorer_metrics" WHERE "compartmentId" = '$COMPARTMENT_ID' AND "namespace" = 'OciLoggingService' AND ("data__json.message" LIKE '%vpn%' OR "data__json.message" LIKE '%appliance%') AND "value" > 0
